title: decalepis khasiana
intro: Decalepis khasiana, commonly known as the Indian gentian, is a rare and endangered succulent plant native to the Western Ghats of India. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Decalepis khasiana include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
